metadata.title: Console College 26 - 2026 Real Players (876, P4 Expanded)
metadata.rating_note: Ratings are game-scale editorial approximations based on 2026 preseason national award recognition / All-America status and selected early-October production; they are not official ratings.
metadata.trait_note: Traits are deliberately limited to on-field game abstractions. They are not factual claims about a real person’s off-field personality or character.
metadata.year_note: Class year is filled where it was verified in the preseason All-America source; null means the importer intentionally preserves the generated roster slot’s class rather than inventing eligibility.
metadata.team_note: Team keys use the exact real-school names from Console College's real_2026 universe, including LSU, Texas A&M, Notre Dame, USC, Auburn, etc.

metadata.timing_note: Designed for v42.2b+: applied only after the four-season history simulation, immediately before the user begins the 2026 world.
metadata.expansion_note: Adds 400 more real 2026 players, heavily prioritizing SEC, Big Ten, Big 12 and ACC programs. Existing star/watch-list ratings remain hand-tuned; added roster-depth ratings are conservative game-scale approximations.
metadata.import_timing: Applied after the four-season history simulation, immediately before the 2026 career begins.
